title: Activist investor Sachem Head takes 6.9% Ionic Digital stake as miner pivots to AI infrastructure
excerpt: The activist investor joined Ionic’s $400 million private placement as the Celsius-born bitcoin miner converts power and land assets into AI/HPC infrastructu...
content_html:
Activist investor Sachem Head Capital Management disclosed a 6.9% beneficial ownership stake in Ionic Digital (NASDAQ: this week, giving the activist investor exposure to the bitcoin miner's shift toward AI/HPC infrastructure.

The position covers 3,169,808 Class A shares. Sachem Head funds directly hold 2,264,150 shares, while warrants account for another 905,658 shares.

Ionic Digital recently listed on the Nasdaq Exchange on July 28 under the ticker IOND, following an emergence from the Celsius Network bankruptcy. The Bitcoin miner turned data center builder received mining assets, $195 million in cash and 540 bitcoin in exchange for issuing 37 million shares to former Celsius creditors.

Activist investment?

Sachem Head acquired the securities through Ionic's $400 million private placement, announced June 26 at a $2 billion pre-money valuation. Sachem Head joined Attestor, Oaktree Capital Management, Citadel and Weiss Asset Management in the financing.

Ionic has already faced shareholder pressure, reaching a corporate governance settlement with stockholders including Figure Markets Holdings and GXD Labs before its 2025 annual meeting.

However, Sachem Head has not disclosed plans for a campaign, leaving its current role as a large investor backing Ionic's capital-intensive conversion from bitcoin mining to AI/HPC infrastructure.

The filing does not disclose Sachem Head's investment cost, request board representation or identify changes sought from management. Sachem Head also filed a Schedule 13G rather than the Schedule 13D generally associated with investors pursuing control or an active influence campaign.

Ionic's AI infrastructure transition

Ionic is repositioning its business from bitcoin mining toward AI/HPC infrastructure. The business emerged from Celsius Network's bankruptcy restructuring in January 2024, receiving mining assets, $195 million in cash and 540 bitcoin in exchange for issuing 37 million shares to former Celsius creditors.

Ionic has since moved to redeploy mining-era power and land for AI/HPC customers. The company operates about 120,000 mining rigs but has been evaluating Texas properties in Glasscock and Reagan counties for data center development, according to Data Center Dynamics.

Its Cedarvale site near Barstow provides the clearest example. Ionic has leased the property to Nscale for 10 years under a deal valued at $2 billion, with the facility intended to serve Microsoft, and is seeking to expand the site to 700 megawatts by the end of 2027.

content_html_zh:
激进投资者 Sachem Head Capital Management 本周披露了 Ionic Digital（纳斯达克股票代码：6.9%）的实益所有权股份，让激进投资者能够了解这家比特币矿商向 AI/HPC 基础设施的转变。

该头寸涵盖 3,169,808 股 A 类股票。 Sachem Head 基金直接持有 2,264,150 股，而认股权证则持有另外 905,658 股。

继摄氏度网络破产后，Ionic Digital 最近于 7 月 28 日在纳斯达克交易所上市，股票代码为 IOND。 这家由比特币矿工转型为数据中心建造商的公司获得了采矿资产、1.95 亿美元现金和 540 枚比特币，以换取向前摄氏度债权人发行 3700 万股股票。

积极投资？

Sachem Head 于 6 月 26 日宣布，通过 Ionic 4 亿美元的私募以 20 亿美元的投前估值收购了这些证券。 Sachem Head 与 Attestor、Oaktree Capital Management、Citadel 和 Weiss Asset Management 一起参与了融资。

Ionic 已经面临股东压力，在 2025 年年会之前与包括Figure Markets Holdings 和 GXD Labs 在内的股东达成了公司治理和解。

然而，Sachem Head 尚未透露活动计划，目前其作为大型投资者的角色支持 Ionic 从比特币挖矿向 AI/HPC 基础设施的资本密集型转型。

该文件没有披露 Sachem Head 的投资成本、请求董事会代表或确定管理层寻求的变更。 Sachem Head 还提交了 Schedule 13G，而不是通常与追求控制权或积极影响力活动的投资者相关的 Schedule 13D。

Ionic 的 AI 基础设施转型

Ionic 正在将其业务从比特币挖矿重新定位为人工智能/高性能计算基础设施。 该业务是在 2024 年 1 月 Celsius Network 的破产重组中诞生的，接收了采矿资产、1.95 亿美元现金和 540 比特币，以换取向 Celsius 前债权人发行 3700 万股股票。

此后，Ionic 开始为 AI/HPC 客户重新部署采矿时代的电力和土地。 据 Data Center Dynamics 称，该公司运营着约 120,000 台采矿设备，但一直在评估德克萨斯州格拉斯科克县和里根县的地产用于数据中心开发。

巴斯托附近的塞达维尔遗址就是最明显的例子。 Ionic 已根据价值 20 亿美元的交易将该物业出租给 Nscale，为期 10 年，该设施旨在为微软提供服务，并寻求在 2027 年底之前将该设施扩大到 700 兆瓦。
